trace.final:
All done. Summary:

1. **Reviewed deployment history** — v2.3.1 (current, unhealthy in production) and v2.3.0 (most recent healthy production release) were identified; v2.3.1-rc was only in staging so it was excluded.
2. **Rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all regions.** The first rollback attempt partially failed (halted after us-east), leaving us-west/eu-west on v2.3.1, so I retried and the rollout completed across us-east, us-west, and eu-west.
3. **Verified recovery** — all regions are on v2.3.0, the service reports healthy, and the error rate dropped from 18% to 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** (on-call paged) documenting the unhealthy deploy, the partial-then-completed rollback, and the recommendation for root-cause investigation of v2.3.1.
